# port_virtual_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages a virtual MCP server under the `_virtual_mcp_server` system blueprint.

A virtual MCP server is a curated MCP endpoint that exposes selected Port and connector tools through `virtual_mcp_tools` and `passthrough_tools`. The `url` attribute is the OAuth MCP endpoint agents should connect to.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "port_virtual_mcp_tool" "list_skills" {
  identifier = "skills_distribution_list_skills"
  title      = "list_skills"
  name       = "list_skills"
  tool       = "list_entities"
}

resource "port_virtual_mcp_server" "skills_distribution" {
  identifier        = "skills_distribution"
  title             = "Skills Distribution"
  passthrough_tools = ["load_skill"]
  virtual_mcp_tools = [port_virtual_mcp_tool.list_skills.identifier]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) The display title of the virtual MCP server

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the virtual MCP server is for
- `icon` (String) The icon of the virtual MCP server
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the virtual MCP server entity (used in the server URL path)
- `instructions` (String) Instructions sent to agents when they connect to this server
- `passthrough_tools` (List of String) Regex patterns of Port or connector tools to expose unchanged
- `teams` (Set of String) The teams the virtual MCP server belongs to
- `virtual_mcp_tools` (List of String) Identifiers of `port_virtual_mcp_tool` entities exposed by this server

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation date of the virtual MCP server
- `created_by` (String) The creator of the virtual MCP server
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update date of the virtual MCP server
- `updated_by` (String) The last updater of the virtual MCP server
- `url` (String) The server's MCP endpoint URL (calculated by Port from the entity identifier)
